dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) — Listed Building polygons, layer 3
evidence_slice: Historic England's current National Heritage List for England API exposes layer 3 as 'Listed Building polygons' with geometry type esriGeometryPolygon and fields ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, CaptureScale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing, released under the Open Government Licence. The official NHLE entry 1495589 identifies 'Exeter Central Station', Grade II, first listed 24-Jul-2026, and describes a purpose-built Southern Railway station building with integrated footbridge/luggageway. An exact no-login layer-3 query for ListEntry=1495589 with returnGeometry=true was attempted, but the feature payload was not retrievable through the available channel; therefore no coordinates were fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon; exact ListEntry=1495589 query requested returnGeometry=true, but the feature payload was not retrievable, so no polygon coordinates were accepted.
field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE record name is Exeter Central Station and its summary explicitly describes a purpose-built railway station building with integrated passenger footbridge/luggageway.
